blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—La Salle will take extra precautions with star Jacob Cortez after he suffered a scary fall during the Green Archers’ overtime win over University of the East on Wednesday. Cortez was helped off the court in the second quarter of La Salle’s 97-88 victory over the Red Warriors in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena. During a drive to the basket, the shifty guard attempted a Euro step and appeared to hyperextend his right knee. He remained on the floor for a time before being […]...
